attempts.summary: Configured a persistent Squid HTTP forward proxy on node1:3128 and a persistent origin service on node2:8081. Only node2 may access the proxy, only HTTP requests to node2:8081 are permitted, and all CONNECT tunnels or other destinations/ports are denied. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 and recovered successfully after sequential reboots.
